tv_script_name: Kaufman Moving Average Adaptive Strategy by MKB
indentation_source: direct DOM extraction (monaco-editor-tv-pine-dark content spans), grouped by bounding-box top coordinate into lines
notes: Classic Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (KAMA, hand-computed efficiency-ratio smoothing constant) with a standard-deviation upper band; long-only entry on price crossing above KAMA+stdev band, exit on price crossing back below KAMA. Author's doc: 'the strategy works best on the daily timeframe... Designed primarily for daily charts', tested on crypto but no domain lock in the mechanism itself (pure price-derived MA). 111 lines, ~6 params.
